target.description: Stimulus-pair decoding across source region pairs, relevance conditions and onset/offset periods; supplementary relevance and cross-task analyses remain distinct. This is not consciousness detection.

dataset.description: COGITATE-derived regional MEG data. Resolve registered Zenodo v1 against author v2 and corrected publication before fixing immutable empirical inputs.

cohort.description: Original analysis uses all 94 participants. An arbitrary smaller roster is not a same-task comparison.

split.description: Original stimulus/relevance analysis uses ten stratified participant-group folds; pinned code shuffles with random_state=127. Exact input ordering and realized membership must be reconstructed. Prospective nested folds are not interchangeable.

inputs.description: Source FC values derive from regional time series averaged by participant and event type. Preserve this condition-averaged input task and its exposure; do not relabel it as single-trial unknown-category prediction.

preprocessing.description: The source z-scores and detrends time series, screens 262 FC measures to 246, then uses the pinned feature-quality and mixed-sigmoid classifier pipeline. Changing screening or train-only scaling must be declared as a method change, with identical evaluation support.

metric.description: Accuracy at probability threshold 0.5: correct held-out predictions divided by held-out observations in each source fold. AUC and balanced accuracy are not replacement primary scores.

aggregation.description: Arithmetic mean and SD across the ten test folds for each source endpoint; region pairs, relevance and stimulus periods stay separately identified. No prospective equal-person aggregation substitution.

comparison.primary_metric: Original mean test-fold face-versus-object accuracy for the selected task-irrelevant first-1000-ms CS↔PFC maximum-squared-DTW-barycenter result, with its complete paired Figure 3c(i–ii) feature/distribution and matching Figure 3a fold profile.

published_baseline.description: Fig. 3c CS–PFC, face versus object, task-irrelevant onset: 64.3% accuracy, SD 9.4 percentage points. Fig. 3b CS–PAR face/false-font is 67.0%, SD 8.3 points. The scalar is a named anchor, not an aggregate or whole-paper victory threshold.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No authenticated rerun. minimum_effect.rationale: Choose a justified decoding-accuracy improvement and selection-aware decision rule on the complete selected Figure 3c(i–ii) paired participant feature/distribution and matching Figure 3a classifier-profile task support before candidate search, retaining the original full-search winner-selection exposure. Neither any positive delta nor stronger significance is a meaningful effect. No numeric margin or decision rule is established.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired participant-level uncertainty for matched candidate/reference predictions on the selected endpoint, accounting for within-participant face/object pairing, overlapping cross-validation training sets and winner-selection/multiplicity exposure across the original searched measures, relevance, timing and collapsed directions. Retaining that exposure does not itself require full-discovery numerical reconstruction for the named result. Fold SD is descriptive and cannot supply an independent-replicate test; a justified selection-aware uncertainty rule remains unresolved.
uncertainty.rationale: The original groups are participants, while the endpoint family is extensive and the published best FC measures were selected across it. A paired effect requires accounting for that selection, without silently changing the source task.

episode.candidate_freeze: Commit candidate code, feature policy, preprocessing, endpoint family, seeds and selection rule before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Replay authenticated reference and frozen candidate on identical original participant folds and selected face/object, irrelevant first-1000-ms ON, symmetric CS↔PFC task support. Retain complete paired participant features/distributions, observation-level probabilities and labels, fold identities/counts, threshold-0.5 accuracies, unweighted fold mean/population SD and separate AUC companions. Granular derivation, numerical agreement, meaningful improvement and participant-aware selection-adjusted inference remain unqualified until independently justified; generated engineering examples are not scientific evidence.
episode.baseline_policy: Source numerical results, authenticated author rerun and any future SOTA comparator are separately labelled. No local nested classifier becomes the published baseline.
